headline: Investigation finds Sheikh Hasina involved in Salahuddin Ahmed's disappearance
summary: The International Crimes Tribunal's investigation agency has found evidence of the involvement of the former PM, Asaduzzaman Khan, and top officials in the 2015 enforced disappearance of the BNP leader.
details: The International Crimes Tribunal's investigation agency has found evidence that former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, Asaduzzaman Khan, and Ziaul Ahsan, along with senior RAB and police officials, were involved in the disappearance of BNP leader Salahuddin Ahmed.
caption:
Investigation reveals former PM Sheikh Hasina ordered the disappearance of BNP leader Salahuddin Ahmed in 2015.

The International Crimes Tribunal's investigation agency has found evidence that former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, Asaduzzaman Khan, and Ziaul Ahsan, along with senior RAB and police officials, were involved in the disappearance of BNP leader Salahuddin Ahmed.

#Bangladesh #Politics #HumanRights #Justice #BNP

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: PM [[hands over appointment letters]] to 10 July victims’ families
headline: PM hands over appointment letters to 10 July victims’ families
summary: The Prime Minister provided employment opportunities and auto-rickshaws to the families of those killed during the July protests.
details: The Prime Minister has distributed appointment letters to the family members of 10 people killed during the July protests.
In addition to government jobs, the Prime Minister also gifted auto-rickshaws to the 'July warriors' to support their livelihoods.
During the event, the Prime Minister emphasized the importance of collective effort to build a 'Beautiful Bangladesh'.
The initiative aims to provide financial stability and sustainable employment to the families affected by the losses during the unrest.
caption:
Jobs and auto-rickshaws for the families of July victims. The Prime Minister steps in to provide support.

The Prime Minister has distributed appointment letters to the family members of 10 people killed during the July protests.

In addition to government jobs, the Prime Minister also gifted auto-rickshaws to the 'July warriors' to support their livelihoods.

During the event, the Prime Minister emphasized the importance of collective effort to build a 'Beautiful Bangladesh'.

The initiative aims to provide financial stability and sustainable employment to the families affected by the losses during the unrest.

#Bangladesh #JulyVictims #GovernmentSupport #Employment #Dhaka

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Somoy News
